Aisha (CS): Quick capture from this morning's renewal health check with Atlas Clinics 14 they raised three product pain points that are driving renewal hesitation. Posting here for triage.
Tom (CS): Notes from call: (1) export slicing by clinic + date (they need per-clinic bundles), (2) time-to-export SLA: must be <90s for hourly runs, (3) better admin audit trails (who queried what & when).
Diego (Support): Saw dup rows once when webhook retries overlapped with a backfill. Ticket S-4277 has traces; not a huge number but customer flagged it as a compliance risk.
Claire (Onboarding): Atlas said auditors rejected their first run because exports lacked clinic-level headers. They described it as "blocking renewal until our auditors pass it."
Maya (PM): Propose we score quickly: Impact (H/M/L) / Effort (S/M/L) / RenewalRisk (Y/N). Also need dataset samples and export job timings.
Aisha (CS): Quick CS vote: export slicing = H / M / Y; export SLA = H / M / Y; admin audit trails = M / S / N.
Diego (Support): Data: Atlas hourly exports ~4500 rows, avg payload 1.6MB, recent export median 3:40, 95th 9:10. Logs attached in S-4277.
Maya (PM): I'll take export SLA + slicing for a short spike (2d). Will create RDW-4510 and RDW-4511. Spike goal: PoC streaming export + per-clinic partitioning; measure median & p95.
Aisha (CS): Can you give an ETA to share with Atlas? They asked for a timeline before their 30-day renewal window closes.
Maya (PM): Spike starts Tuesday; expect a write-up + numbers by Thursday EOD. If PoC looks good, we'll schedule engineering work in next sprint.
Claire (Onboarding): I'll ask Atlas to upload a full schema and their largest export sample.
Diego (Support): I'll link S-4277 and include webhook traces if we need to triage dedupe behavior.
redwoodbot: Reminder: include customer reference and attach onboarding notes when filing tickets.
Tom (CS): Action items: 1) Claire collect samples, 2) Maya create tickets + run spike, 3) Diego attach logs, 4) Aisha update renewal tracker.
Aisha (CS): Scheduling 20m sync Friday 11:00 to review spike results and agree next steps. :calendar: 
Maya (PM): Tagging @Maya for visibility. Will post RDW numbers when tasks are created.
Tom (CS): Closing loop here 14 I'll flag export-SLA and slicing as renewal-risk in the feedback tracker. :white_check_mark:
